title: Hearty Syrian Lamb Bowl
description: Savory, dense, date-night Syrian dish featuring a creamy garlic tahini sauce, sous‑vide lamb, and fluffy quinoa paired with chickpeas.

ingredients.name: Lamb shoulder, boneless
ingredients.notes: Trim excess fat, cut into 2.5 cm cubes

instructions: Season lamb cubes with salt, coriander, cumin, smoked paprika, and 1 tbsp olive oil; toss to coat.
Place lamb in a vacuum seal bag, add minced garlic and lemon juice, seal.
Cook lamb in sous‑vide bath for 2 hours. While lamb cooks, rinse and drain quinoa, and warm chickpeas.
After 45 minutes, reduce heat to 135°F (57°C) to finish thicker juices.
When lamb is done, remove from bag, pat dry, and sear briefly in a hot skillet with remaining olive oil for 1‑2 minutes per side for a crust.
In a small bowl whisk tahini, warm water, remaining lemon juice, and a pinch of salt until smooth; adjust thickness with water if needed.
Assemble bowls: layer quinoa, chickpeas, seared lamb, top with garlic tahini sauce. Sprinkle sumac, chopped parsley, and diced tomatoes if using.
Serve warm, garnished with extra parsley.
Optional: serve with flatbread or side salad.
